description: Scaffold the backend pnpm workspace monorepo and implement the @clinvo/shared package with Drizzle schemas, TypeScript types, and utility functions. This is the foundation every other package depends on.
steps: Install pnpm globally: npm install -g pnpm@9.12.0

Create backend/docker-compose.yml with a postgres:16-alpine service (port 5432, volume pg_data, env POSTGRES_PASSWORD/USER/DB from .env) and a redis:7-alpine service (port 6379). Both on network clinvo-net.

Create backend/.env.example with all required vars:
  DATABASE_URL=postgresql://clinvo:password@localhost:5432/clinvo_dev
  REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
  ADMIN_SECRET_KEY=<generate-a-long-random-string>
  JWT_SECRET=<generate-a-long-random-string>
  JWT_EXPIRY=8h
  INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY=<generate-a-long-random-string>
  RESEND_API_KEY=re_...
  EMAIL_FROM=Clinvo <noreply@clinvo.in>
  PORT_LICENSE=3001
  PORT_NOTIFY=3003
  NODE_ENV=development

Create backend/packages/shared/ with this structure:
  package.json
  tsconfig.json
  src/
    index.ts          (barrel export)
    types.ts          (TypeScript interfaces for all DB entities)
    schema.ts         (Drizzle ORM table definitions)
    db.ts             (createDb factory function)
    utils/
      crypto.ts       (hashApiKey, generateApiKey)
      pagination.ts   (parsePaginationQuery helper)
    zod/
      license.ts      (Zod schemas for license API)
      tenant.ts       (Zod schemas for tenant API)
      plan.ts         (Zod schemas for plan API)
      auth.ts         (Zod schema for admin login)

backend/packages/shared/package.json:
{
  "name": "@clinvo/shared",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } },
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "scripts": { "build": "tsc", "dev": "tsc --watch" },
  "dependencies": {
    "drizzle-orm": "0.45.4",
    "postgres": "3.4.9",
    "zod": "3.25.67"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "5.8.3",
    "drizzle-kit": "0.31.11",
    "@types/node": "24.0.10"
  }
}
Note: use the exact versions listed here. For zod use latest 3.x — check with npm view zod version.

backend/packages/shared/tsconfig.json:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true
  },
  "include": ["src"]
}

Implement backend/packages/shared/src/schema.ts using drizzle-orm/pg-core. Define pgTable for: tenants, plans, plan_features, licenses, license_feature_overrides, license_events. Use pgEnum for license status ('active','paused','expired','cancelled'). Use uuid().defaultRandom() for PK fields. Use timestamp({ withTimezone: true }) for all timestamp columns. Export all table objects and the licenseStatusEnum.

Implement backend/packages/shared/src/zod/license.ts — Zod schemas:
  - IssueLicenseBody: tenantId (uuid), planId (uuid), expiresAt (ISO date string), notes (optional string), env ('live'|'test', default 'live')
  - UpdateLicenseStatusBody: status (LicenseStatus enum)
  - UpdateLicenseExpiryBody: expiresAt (ISO date string)
  - UpdateLicenseFeaturesBody: features (Record<string, string>)
  - PaginationQuerySchema: page (coerce number, default 1), pageSize (coerce number, default 20)

Implement backend/packages/shared/src/zod/tenant.ts:
  - CreateTenantBody: name, ownerName, ownerEmail (email), ownerPhone (optional)

Implement backend/packages/shared/src/zod/plan.ts:
  - CreatePlanBody: name, description (optional), priceInr (number), features (Record<string, string>)

Implement backend/packages/shared/src/zod/auth.ts:
  - AdminLoginBody: username (string), password (string)
Implement backend/packages/shared/src/index.ts as a barrel that re-exports everything from types.ts, schema.ts, db.ts, utils/crypto.ts, utils/pagination.ts, and all zod schemas.
